entities.name: Phenyl isocyanate
observations: The isocyanate carbon is the predicted reaction center.

entities.name: Chiral amino alcohol
observations: Contains a secondary alcohol and a tertiary bridgehead amine; the alcohol oxygen is the predicted nucleophile.

entities.name: O-phenyl carbamate product
observations: Assignment is mechanistic inference rather than an experimentally confirmed exact database record.

entities.name: Isocyanate carbamate formation
observations: Alcohol addition to phenyl isocyanate is predicted to form an O-phenyl carbamate.
The tertiary amine is not expected to form the major covalent product because it lacks an N–H bond.
